hero.subtitle_html: Photo via hikr.org - Hohtürli and Blüemlisalp

intro_html: Traverse to Switzerland's highest pass in the Bernese Alps, passing turquoise Oeschinensee and the historic Blüemlisalphütte hut. Spectacular alpine panorama.

photos.alt: Hohtürli ridge and Blüemlisalp from the hike

routes.title_html: Kandersteg → Oeschinen Lake → Oeschinen Pass → Blüemlisalphüette → Hohtürli Pass (classical T3 traverse)

getting_there.by_pt_html: Train: Bern HB → Frutigen (30 min) → Kandersteg (10 min). Plan via sbb.ch — typically a direct regional train from Bern. Kandersteg is a car-free mountain village with shuttle buses from the main parking area to the trailhead.
getting_there.by_car_html: Drive to Kandersteg via the A6 freeway from Frutigen (Bern direction). Follow regional roads toward the Oeschinen valley. Pay parking is available at the Kandersteg trailhead area near the lake access.

lapse_rate.example_html: Example: 20 °C at Kandersteg → ~7 °C at Hohtürli summit

weather.season_html: July–September is the main season; the hut is typically open from mid-June to mid-October. Snow can linger into July; avoid after fresh snowfall as the pass terrain becomes serious.

reports.title: Kandersteg to Hohtürli — Alpine traverse
bullets_html: • Exposed alpine ridge with cairns; wind can be extreme

reports.title: Oeschinen Pass to Blüemlisalphüette hut overnight
bullets_html: • Two-day trip allows rest at historic SAC hut
• Turquoise Oeschinen Lake is photogenic early-morning stop

gear.title: Essential
items_html:
• Hiking poles
  • Sun protection (cream + glasses + hat)
  • 2 L water
  • Emergency snacks

safety_html: Turn back if thunderstorms develop — lightning risk above treeline is extreme.
resources_html: SAC Route Portal — Hohtürli & Blüemlisalphütte
disclaimer_html: This page is an informal hike plan, not professional mountain-safety advice. Conditions change rapidly. Always check MeteoSwiss and SAC before setting out.
